info.title: Reply Universal API
info.description: Manage Reply campaigns, contacts, sequences, schedules, and outreach emails

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

emailAccounts[].description: Email accounts used to send campaign emails.

scheduleId.description: Optional Reply schedule identifier for the campaign.

settings.daysToFinishProspect.description: Days taken for a prospect to finish the sequence.

settings.emailSendingDelaySeconds.description: Delay between email sends in seconds.

settings.repliesHandlingType.description: How Reply handles responses to the campaign.

settings.useDailyThrottling.description: Whether Reply enforces the daily throttling limit.

steps[].inMinutesCount.description: Delay in minutes before the step runs.

steps[].templates[].attachmentsIds[].description: Attachment identifiers for the template variant.

steps[].templates[].body.description: Custom body text for the step template variant.

steps[].templates[].ccList.description: Comma-separated CC recipients for the template variant.

steps[].templates[].emailTemplateId.description: Existing Reply email template identifier for the variant.

steps[].templates[].subject.description: Custom subject text for the step template variant.

useDefaultEmailAccountFallback.description: Assign the default email account when no explicit account is provided.

emailAccounts.description: Sending email accounts associated with the campaign.

settings.description: Campaign sending settings returned by Reply.

steps.description: Campaign step definitions returned by Reply.

useDefaultEmailAccountFallback.description: Whether Reply falls back to a default sending account.
